recovery_policy: Restore requires an independently retained expected logical-state SHA-256. A self-supplied digest cannot authenticate edited history.
sequence_policy: New assessment ledger has its own consecutive ordinal 1..n; existing evidence ledger sequence 10..n*10 is preserved. BEFORE INSERT refuses explicitly assigned positive ordinals; API rejects any ordinal field.
fixture_policy: Earlier v8 synthetic fixture includes actual evidence events; new bundles are complete explicit rows. Literal graphs derive from the earlier hand-authored oracle, never SQL output.
